name: Short Syntax
description:
A short syntax is the fusion of a binary operator with the ``=`` operator. That way, the operator is applied to the right hand operand, and the left variable, then, assigned to that variable. 

It is convenient when the variable has to be processed then assigned again to itself.
code:
<?php

    $a = 0;
    // Adds 2 to $a
    $a = $a + 2;
    
    // short syntax to add 3 to $a
    $a += 3;

?>
